checks.name: First visit with prompt permission does not call GPS or any provider until Enable
Enable explicitly requests once, fetches real transport format, persists weather and opt-in
Reload with granted permission refreshes automatically without an app modal or Apply
Already-granted browser permission enables silent first refresh without a saved config
Reopened prompt permission uses saved coordinates with an honest fallback label, zero GPS prompts
Reopened denied permission uses saved coordinates with an honest fallback label, zero GPS prompts
Unsupported Permissions API does not attempt silent GPS; saved place only
Unsupported/denied with no saved place does not fabricate location or weather
Saved named city refreshes automatically without replacing it with GPS
Manual weather and explicit not-assessed choice never get overwritten automatically
Explicitly turning auto off survives recreation without revoking or asking browser permission
Fresh foreground/generate checks throttle requests; older readings refresh
Follow-today mode uses today without overwriting the saved historical outfit ledger
Explicit fixed work date is honored; daily forecast is not mislabeled current
Out-of-forecast date retains the previous weather and reports the transport error
Offline and timeout responses retain good previous data; no false successful weather
Explicit denied permission does not save auto opt-in or replace prior manual weather
Cancellation stops late responses from overwriting manual weather
Manual weather changed during lookup wins even without explicit cancellation
Corrupt settings and cross-tab modifications are retained rather than reset
Repeated concurrent refresh calls share one location/weather request
Only separate weather keys are written; wear and Favorites remain identical

scope: Simulated permission states and provider replies through actual transport code, not actual iOS permission or a live Open-Meteo check.
